posts.text:
I visited @foodbankofsaz to hear from folks impacted by Republican SNAP cuts. One person works 60 hours a month with a disability but no longer qualifies for SNAP. Another woman uses SNAP as a bridge while raising her son and going to school.  
 
Moms. People with disabilities. Students. Veterans. Active-duty servicemembers. All struggling to put food on the table because Republicans cut food assistance to pay for tax cuts for billionaires. This is wrong and I’m fighting hard to fix it.
